rows.en:
A dogfight against the variable fighters of every era now begins. As a Valkyrie
pilot, you must never lose. Win, whatever it takes.

Between sky and earth,
show your strength!
rows.notes: Flavor title. Line 1 is a little over the estimated box (the Japanese is only 7 characters); other objectives in this box run far wider.

rows.en:
Ranka: "I think this mission will be a tougher fight than any before...
But I'll cheer you on with all my heart! Please win... you have to win!"
rows.notes: Ranka speaks politely to the player here (watashi, desu/masu). Second sentence repeats 'zettai' with a pause: kept as a halting repetition.

rows.en:
On the starlit stage,
show your strength!

Sheryl: "This mission is going to be a tougher fight than ever before.
But I'm the one cheering you on, so you'd better win, no matter what!"

Win the battle against
Vermillion Flight.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Vermillion Flight.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Vermillion Flight.

Win the battle against
the Skull Leaders.
rows.notes: Skull Leaders = the Skull Squadron leaders of each era (Focker, Hikaru, Max in this mission). Plural of the glossary mission title 'Skull Leader'; the team name itself is not in the glossary.

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Skull Leaders.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Skull Leaders.
rows.notes: See u3092.

rows.en:
Win the battle against
the 2090s ace pilots.
rows.notes: 2090s = Macross II era (Silvie Gena's team).

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the ace pilots of the 2090s.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the 2090s ace pilots.

Win the battle against Armored
Valkyries of every era.
rows.notes: Glossary 'Armored Valkyrie' is provisional.

rows.en:
To test your combat experience, you will now battle the Armored Valkyries of every era.
Trust in your skill and defeat them all.
rows.notes: Glossary 'Armored Valkyrie' is provisional. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Win the battle against
Sound Force.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Sound Force.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Sound Force.

Win the battle against
the Protodeviln.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Protodeviln.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Protodeviln.

Win the battle against
the Sturmvogel IIs.
rows.notes: The Japanese says only 'Sturmvogel'. The enemy team (Max, Milia, Gamlin) flies VF-22S Sturmvogel II, so 'Sturmvogel IIs' (glossary unit name).

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Sturmvogel IIs.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Sturmvogel IIs.
rows.notes: See u3102.

rows.en:
Win the battle against
Pixie Team.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Pixie Team.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Pixie Team.

Win the battle against
the Meltrandi aces.
rows.notes: Japanese uses the short form 'Meltran' + gekitsuiou (flying ace); the team is Milia and Chlore, so plural.

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Meltrandi aces.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Meltrandi aces.

Win the battle against
Sagittarius Squadron.
rows.notes: Glossary 'Sagittarius Squadron' is provisional.

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Sagittarius Squadron.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Sagittarius Squadron.
rows.notes: Glossary 'Sagittarius Squadron' is provisional.

rows.en:
Win the battle against S.M.S.
Skull Squadron.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle S.M.S. Skull Squadron.
Trust in your own skill and defeat S.M.S. Skull Squadron.

Win the battle against
Diamond Force.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Diamond Force.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Diamond Force.

Win the battle against
Antares Squadron.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Antares Squadron.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Antares Squadron.

Win the battle against the
Mardook commander.
rows.notes: Japanese has no number; the mission's only named enemy is Feff, so singular.

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Mardook commander.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Mardook commander.
rows.notes: See u3116.

rows.en:
Win the battle against the Destroid
Monsters of every era.
rows.notes: Konig Monster, Destroid Monster and Prototype Monster in this mission.

rows.en:
To test your combat experience, you will now battle the Destroid Monsters.
Trust in your skill and defeat the Destroid Monsters of every era.
rows.notes: First mention has no 'rekidai' in the Japanese, the second has it; kept that way. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Win the battle against
Moon Island Platoon.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Moon Island Platoon.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Moon Island Platoon.

Win the battle against the
next-gen main VFs.
rows.notes: Jiki shuryoku kahen sentouki = the next main variable fighters (Isamu's YF-19, Guld's YF-21 in Project Super Nova).

rows.en:
To test your combat experience, you will now battle the next-generation mainstay VFs.
Trust in your skill and defeat them all.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Win the battle against
the Bird Human.
rows.notes: Line 1 is over its per-line estimate only because the Japanese line 1 is 5 characters; the row stays within the other objectives' width.

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Bird Human.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Bird Human.

Win the battle against
Golg Boddole Zer.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Supreme Commander Golg Boddole Zer.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Boddole Zer.
rows.notes: Kantai shirei choukan = Supreme Commander (glossary alias). The Japanese repeats the full title; the second mention is shortened to 'Boddole Zer' to fit two lines.

rows.en:
Win the battle against
the Mardook fleet.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Mardook fleet.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Mardook fleet.

Win the battle against
Sharon Apple.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Sharon Apple.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Sharon Apple.

Win the battle against
Gepelnitchi.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle His Excellency Gepelnitchi.
Trust in your own skill and defeat His Excellency Gepelnitchi.
rows.notes: Kakka = 'His Excellency', as in the prefilled MC_110 briefing (u3204).

rows.en:
Win the battle against
the Vajra Queen.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Vajra Queen.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Vajra Queen.
Win the fight against Hayao Kakizaki.

Hayao Kakizaki gripes that his machine is why he never gets to shine.
To shut him up, beat Kakizaki in mock battles in all sorts of units.
rows.notes: Kanshou = win completely; rendered 'beat outright'. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en: Fight wild with a burning heart!
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept.

rows.en:
Basara: "From here on, it's time for our FIRE BOMBER red-hot live show!
All right, let's go out with a bang! Listen to my song!!"
rows.notes: FIRE BOMBER in capitals as the Japanese writes it (glossary alias). Catchphrase per glossary note.

rows.en:
Set your ecstasy ablaze
in a one-of-a-kind fight!
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept.

rows.en:
Sheryl: "From here on, it's time for a special live show. Ready, Ranka?"
Ranka: "Yes! Everybody, hold me tight! To the ends of the galaxy!! Kira☆"
rows.notes: Sheryl says 'Ranka-chan'; mission text follows the MUF style without honorifics (brief), so 'Ranka'. Ranka's catchphrase at full force. Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
You who trust your wings,
race beyond time and space!

Fold quartz, which can leap even time and causality, has brought pilots and
machines from across time and space. Win this dreamlike battle against them!
rows.notes: Japanese: win the dreamlike battle against the many pilots and machines from beyond time and space who appeared through fold quartz's power. Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
Clear the "Macross Zero"
missions in a row

You will now take on the 8 "Macross Zero" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!
Clear the "Macross Zero" missions in a row

Find the Bird Human's head and
retrieve it to the target area.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept.

rows.en:
The Bird Human's head: another AFOS fragment, newly found on Mayan Island.
Find it before the Anti-U.N. Forces do and bring it to the target area.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept.

rows.en:
Clear the "Super Dimension Fortress
Macross" missions in a row
rows.notes: x2. Series title without the leading 'The' to fit the line. Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en:
You will now take on the 17 "Super Dimension Fortress Macross" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

You will now take on the 8 "Super Dimension Fortress Macross" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

Clear the "Do You Remember Love?"
missions in a row

You will now take on the 8 "Do You Remember Love?" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

Clear the "Macross Plus"
missions in a row

You will now take on the 13 "Macross Plus" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

Pass each waypoint as it is designated,
as quickly as you can.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept.

rows.en:
A flight test now begins to measure the prototype's thrust, agility and more.
Run a time trial to measure how long you take to clear all the waypoints.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept.

rows.en:
Subdue the U.N. soldiers who've run
amok at the anniversary ceremony.
rows.notes: Prefilled line was over the box; compressed 'U.N. Forces soldiers who have' to 'U.N. soldiers who've'.

rows.en:
U.N. troops have run amok at the anniversary ceremony in Macross City, Earth.
To end this crisis of unknown cause, subdue the rampaging soldiers at once.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept.

rows.en:
Clear the "Macross 7"
missions in a row

You will now take on the 14 "Macross 7" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

Just as City 7 is dragged toward a blazing star, the Varauta Army attacks.
Annihilate the Varauta Army at once and escape from the star.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept.

rows.en:
Clear the "Dynamite 7"
missions in a row
rows.notes: Japanese writes 'Dynamite 7' without 'Macross'; kept as written.

rows.en:
You will now take on the 5 "Dynamite 7" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!
